title: Blockade of Eger
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Blockade of Eger", at revision 1370749921, opens: "The Blockade of Eger was an attempt to blockade the Swedish garrison of Eger conducted by Jan van der Croon. The blockade would be broken by a Swedish relief force under Hans Christoff von Königsmarck." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q140662870, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1647-1648 siege of the Thirty Years' War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
